card.name: Quantity words before an amount
card.fires_on: Words that set up how much of something is present or obtained, such as some, all, any, little, less, much, or a verb like provide or gain. The next word is likely amount or degree of a substance or quality.

modes.label: Quantifier before a thing
modes.description: Words like some, all, little, less, much or any that lead into an amount of a substance or quality.

modes.label: Verb of supplying or obtaining
modes.description: Verbs such as provide, gain, supplies or get that precede a quantity of something obtained.
modes.example: the more important it is to have shoes that<< provide>> shock absorption in order to shield the heel

modes.label: Size or capacity units
modes.description: A unit or the word of after a number, in allocated resource amounts.
modes.example: you may be allocated 8<<GB>> of RAM and 400GB

card.plain: It fires on small words that signal how much of something there is, right before a word like amount or degree.
